---
description: places_route as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
arguments:
  to: "The place to reach, by name."
  from: "Where from; left out, where the player's character is."
  mode: "walk, road, offroad, water or air; left out, every way there is."
---
Reads the way between two places by each mode of travel: how long it takes, how far it is, and the legs it runs by. A mode with no way is listed as none. Nothing is changed.
